scope: One bounded offline 32-training/32-validation independent-seed continuation at the unchanged native 100k setting; no optimizer or IOC
seed_design: Fresh positive odd seeds from numpy default_rng(2026111307), disjoint from all B2-B6 recorded particle seeds; no old held-out populations reused
noise_scale_calibration: sqrt(mean over training points of sample variance of corrected measurements divided by mean predicted noise variance)); training only, no point-specific fitted factors
noise_validation: Apply the training-only global noise scale, then compare held-out frame minus calibration mean against sqrt(frame noise variance plus calibration-mean noise variance); no fitting on held-out populations
input_frames: Reuse native_100k primary frames and accepted reference evidence from B5 only; unscale their inherited B4.1 noise before applying the new training-only scale
reference_policy: Reconstruct B5 primary curves with new scaled relative weights; require unchanged emittance within 1e-8 relative error and retain B5 independent reference acceptance
failure_policy: Retain every failed frame; no clipping, retries, rejection, per-point factors, held-out refitting or alternative-arm selection
continuation: Preserve B2-B6, retain global-scalar estimator and all acceptance gates. Run exactly 32 fresh training plus 32 fresh validation seeds; no early success, extension, retries or held-out refitting. Runtime and future-query-noise acceptance remain separate before a new benchmark.

seed_bootstrap.unit: Resample complete seed vectors across all 36 optical points; no independent frame resampling
seed_bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive uncertainty only, no new pass criterion. Held-out intervals condition on the frozen fitted scale and training means; they exclude training-fit uncertainty.
